faq_heading: South Surrey and White Rock schools: your questions answered

blocks.text: South Surrey and White Rock are both in School District 36 (Surrey). The district groups each secondary school with the elementary schools that feed it, and this page lists those four families with the street address of every school, taken from the BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list.

Catchments are set by street address, not by neighbourhood name, so two homes a block apart can fall into different schools. Check the exact address in the district's School Locator and again before you remove subjects.

blocks.text: French Immersion has its own registration. Crescent Park, Jessie Lee, Laronde and Peace Arch Elementary feed French Immersion into Earl Marriott Secondary. The Ministry file also marks Pacific Heights Elementary as offering French Immersion, so ask the district how that program is fed. White Rock is not one catchment: White Rock Elementary feeds Semiahmoo Secondary and Peace Arch Elementary feeds Earl Marriott.

faq.q: Which school district covers South Surrey and White Rock?
Which secondary schools serve South Surrey and White Rock?
faq.a: Earl Marriott, Elgin Park, Grandview Heights and Semiahmoo Secondary each have a group of feeder elementary schools. Which one applies depends on the exact street address.

faq.q: Does all of White Rock go to the same secondary school?
faq.a: No. White Rock Elementary feeds Semiahmoo Secondary, while Peace Arch Elementary feeds Earl Marriott Secondary.
